dz: 圣特莱马丘斯试图阻止一场在罗马的角斗士战,被人群用石头砸死. 此举令基督教皇帝霍诺利乌斯印象深刻,他颁发了历史上禁止角斗士战斗的禁令.
de: Saint Telemachus tries to stop a gladiatorial fight in a Roman amphitheatre, and is stoned to death by the crowd. This act impresses the Christian Emperor Honorius, who issues a historic ban on gladiatorial fights.

t: 拜占庭皇后欧多克西亚因第七次怀孕流产而去世.
te: Byzantine Empress Eudoxia dies from the miscarriage of her seventh pregnancy.
dz: 拜占庭皇后欧多克西亚因第七次怀孕流产而去世.
de: Byzantine Empress Eudoxia dies from the miscarriage of her seventh pregnancy.
